Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICSIL Law Officer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICSIL Law Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the ICSIL Law Officer position is scheduled for 01 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Law Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an LLB degree from a recognized university. Preference will be given to those with an LLM degree. Additionally, 5-7 years of experience in legal matters is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Law Officer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Law Officer post is 45 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided details.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Law Officer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 50,000/-. EPF will be applicable as per regulations.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Law Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Law Officer position in the Intelligent Communication Systems India (ICSIL) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the ICSIL Law Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 590/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification, a Walk-in Interview, and an Interaction session with the selection panel.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the ICSIL office in New Delhi. The specific address is 110006.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a contractual or permanent job?
faq.answer: The job offered is on a contractual basis.
